about: Everything subpowers depends on in the vendor CLIs, as pure data. bin/canary checks each item against the CLI's own --help / --version / models / login output and reports DRIFT when one disappears. Derived by grepping bin/chatgpt-image, bin/antigravity-image, bin/grok-image, bin/subpowers, bin/doctor and bin/update-codex for every flag they pass and every output string they parse. When a painter starts depending on something new, add an item here; never list anything the code does not use.

placeholders.$tmpdir: a fresh empty temp directory, created by bin/canary for the probe

item_types.flag: the token appears in the probe output as its own flag (delimited, never inside a longer flag)
item_types.regex: python re.search over the whole combined stdout+stderr of the probe
